enum B1 0b 1b
fn b1_to_bits List n:B1
    # bit $n 0b;#false 1b;#true
    list_1 ~ $bit
fn nat_to_b1! B1 n:Nat
    SplitOne default_split val;#false rest;$empty_list
    split_first maybe_split $n.bits
    unwrap_or split $default_split $maybe_split
    is_empty are_no_more $split.rest
    assert! _ $are_no_more
    # ~ $split.val true;#1b false;#0b
fn nat_to_b1 Option n:Nat
    pow least_invalid $2 $1
    ge_nat is_failure $n $least_invalid
    delay1 success_thunk $nat_to_b1! $n
    compose2_0 some_success_thunk $success_thunk $mk_some
    just just_none $none
    lazy_if ~ $is_failure $just_none $some_success_thunk
fn b1_to_nat Nat n:B1
    b1_to_bits bits $n
    trimr_while trimmed_bits $not $bits
    Nat ~ bits;$trimmed_bits

enum B2 00b 01b 10b 11b
fn bottom_bit_2 Bool n:B2
    # ~ $n 00b;#false 01b;#true 10b;#false 11b;#true
fn non_bottom_bits_2 B1 n:B2
    # ~ $n 00b;#0b 01b;#0b 10b;#1b 11b;#1b
fn b2_to_bits List n:B2
    non_bottom_bits_2 non_bottom $n
    bottom_bit_2 bottom $n
    b1_to_bits bits_non_bottom $non_bottom
    push_front ~ $bits_non_bottom $bottom
fn b2_if_bottom_1 B2 non_bottom:B1
    # ~ $non_bottom 0b;#01b 1b;#11b
fn b2_if_bottom_0 B2 non_bottom:B1
    # ~ $non_bottom 0b;#00b 1b;#10b
fn b2_with_bottom B2 bottom:Bool non_bottom:B1
    op1_if ~ $bottom $b2_if_bottom_1 $b2_if_bottom_0 $non_bottom
fn nat_to_b2! B2 n:Nat
    SplitOne default_split val;#false rest;$empty_list
    split_first maybe_split $n.bits
    unwrap_or split $default_split $maybe_split
    Nat rest_n bits;$split.rest
    nat_to_b1! non_bottom $rest_n
    b2_with_bottom ~ $split.val $non_bottom
fn nat_to_b2 Option n:Nat
    pow least_invalid $2 $2
    ge_nat is_failure $n $least_invalid
    delay1 success_thunk $nat_to_b2! $n
    compose2_0 some_success_thunk $success_thunk $mk_some
    just just_none $none
    lazy_if ~ $is_failure $just_none $some_success_thunk
fn b2_to_nat Nat n:B2
    b2_to_bits bits $n
    trimr_while trimmed_bits $not $bits
    Nat ~ bits;$trimmed_bits

fn b7_to_bits List n:B7
    non_bottom_bits_7 non_bottom $n
    bottom_bit_7 bottom $n
    b6_to_bits bits_non_bottom $non_bottom
    push_front ~ $bits_non_bottom $bottom

    # ~ $non_bottom 000000b;#0000001b 000001b;#0000011b 000010b;#0000101b 000011b;#0000111b 000100b;#0001001b 000101b;#0001011b 000110b;#0001101b 000111b;#0001111b 001000b;#0010001b 001001b;#0010011b 001010b;#0010101b 001011b;#0010111b 001100b;#0011001b 001101b;#0011011b 001110b;#0011101b 001111b;#0011111b 010000b;#0100001b 010001b;#0100011b 010010b;#0100101b 010011b;#0100111b 010100b;#0101001b 010101b;#0101011b 010110b;#0101101b 010111b;#0101111b 011000b;#0110001b 011001b;#0110011b 011010b;#0110101b 011011b;#0110111b 011100b;#0111001b 011101b;#0111011b 011110b;#0111101b 011111b;#0111111b 100000b;#1000001b 100001b;#1000011b 100010b;#1000101b 100011b;#1000111b 100100b;#1001001b 100101b;#1001011b 100110b;#1001101b 100111b;#1001111b 101000b;#1010001b 101001b;#1010011b 101010b;#1010101b 101011b;#1010111b 101100b;#1011001b 101101b;#1011011b 101110b;#1011101b 101111b;#1011111b 110000b;#1100001b 110001b;#1100011b 110010b;#1100101b 110011b;#1100111b 110100b;#1101001b 110101b;#1101011b 110110b;#1101101b 110111b;#1101111b 111000b;#1110001b 111001b;#1110011b 111010b;#1110101b 111011b;#1110111b 111100b;#1111001b 111101b;#1111011b 111110b;#1111101b 111111b;#1111111b

fn b7_with_bottom B7 bottom:Bool non_bottom:B6
    op1_if ~ $bottom $b7_if_bottom_1 $b7_if_bottom_0 $non_bottom
fn nat_to_b7! B7 n:Nat
    SplitOne default_split val;#false rest;$empty_list
    split_first maybe_split $n.bits
    unwrap_or split $default_split $maybe_split
    Nat rest_n bits;$split.rest
    nat_to_b6! non_bottom $rest_n
    b7_with_bottom ~ $split.val $non_bottom
fn nat_to_b7 Option n:Nat
    pow least_invalid $2 $7
    ge_nat is_failure $n $least_invalid
    delay1 success_thunk $nat_to_b7! $n
    compose2_0 some_success_thunk $success_thunk $mk_some
    just just_none $none
    lazy_if ~ $is_failure $just_none $some_success_thunk
fn b7_to_nat Nat n:B7
    b7_to_bits bits $n
    trimr_while trimmed_bits $not $bits
    Nat ~ bits;$trimmed_bits

fn b8_with_bottom B8 bottom:Bool non_bottom:B7
    op1_if ~ $bottom $b8_if_bottom_1 $b8_if_bottom_0 $non_bottom
fn nat_to_b8! B8 n:Nat
    SplitOne default_split val;#false rest;$empty_list
    split_first maybe_split $n.bits
    unwrap_or split $default_split $maybe_split
    Nat rest_n bits;$split.rest
    nat_to_b7! non_bottom $rest_n
    b8_with_bottom ~ $split.val $non_bottom
fn nat_to_b8 Option n:Nat
    pow least_invalid $2 $8
    ge_nat is_failure $n $least_invalid
    delay1 success_thunk $nat_to_b8! $n
    compose2_0 some_success_thunk $success_thunk $mk_some
    just just_none $none
    lazy_if ~ $is_failure $just_none $some_success_thunk
fn b8_to_nat Nat n:B8
    b8_to_bits bits $n
    trimr_while trimmed_bits $not $bits
    Nat ~ bits;$trimmed_bits
